page_title: MAR 2-2 TOU | Marseille v Toulouse 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Guillaume Restes comfortably gathers the ball.

90+2' 2 - 2 Mark McKenzie shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 2:2.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matt O'Riley (Marseille) comes onto the pitch so that Igor Paixao can be given a rest.
90' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Emerson is replaced by CJ Egan-Riley (Marseille).
89' Frank Magri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse).
88' Toulouse are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
85' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Emersonn will be replaced by Noah Edjouma (Toulouse).
85' Substitution. Djibril Sidibe makes his way off the pitch and Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) comes on as his replacement.
84' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Marseille.
81' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) is awarded a yellow card.
81' 76:24 – the ratio of ball possession.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is replacing Dayann Methalie.
77' Substitution. Bilal Nadir did his best and is replaced by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
76' Substitution. Nayef Aguerd makes way for Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille).
76' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Rafik Messali (Toulouse) replaces Alexis Vossah.
75' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
74' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) does well to meet a cross inside the box and produces a perfect header which goes low inside the left post.
72' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
69' Emerson (Marseille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
66' 1 - 1 Igor Paixao (Marseille) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
66' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Geronimo Rulli (Marseille).
65' Emersonn (Toulouse) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.

63' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Mason Greenwood (Marseille), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
62' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
59' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' Igor Paixao (Marseille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Marseille force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

53' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
51' Emersonn (Toulouse) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
50' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

50' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Marseille will take a corner.
49' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
48' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.

46' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Alexis Vossah (Toulouse). Eric Wattellier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Marseille are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' Half-time substitution. Roberto De Zerbi decided to make a change. Angel Gomes is replaced by Robinio Vaz (Marseille).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting corner from Emerson (Marseille) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

45+2' Timothy Weah (Marseille) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Marseille.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A cross from Timothy Weah (Marseille) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
42' Angel Gomes (Marseille) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
42' A clumsy foul by Angel Gomes (Marseille) and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle.
41' A pass lands at the feet of Emersonn (Toulouse) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
40' Marseille fail to score from a corner as Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) leaps to collect the ball.

40' Angel Gomes (Marseille) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Marseille win a corner kick.
39' Angel Gomes (Marseille) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
37' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle after Bilal Nadir (Marseille) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
36' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Guillaume Restes comfortably gathers the ball.
34' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
32' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
30' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
29' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
29' Frank Magri (Toulouse) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Eric Wattellier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
27' Flag goes up against Igor Paixao (Marseille) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
26' Emerson (Marseille) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
26' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Marseille in a dangerous position.
23' Igor Paixao (Marseille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
22' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Neat passing move from Marseille in order to create new attacking opportunities.

14' 0 - 1 Emersonn (Toulouse) goes on a mazy run, perfectly slipping past the opposition's defence. He aims well and places a precise low drive towards the bottom right corner, ricocheting in off the post! Wonderful goal! Total football.
13' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes.
11' Frank Magri (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
9' Great teamplay by Marseille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Emersonn (Toulouse) heads on.
3' A raking crossfield pass from Frank Magri (Toulouse) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Toulouse will kick the game off.
